notes.title: PATCH 0.24.71
notes.notes:
Pet System

Prepare to unlock new bonds, discover hidden potentials, and traverse uncharted territories alongside your faithful companions. With enhanced features and mysterious surprises awaiting, the adventure awaits those daring enough to explore the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/5a111f460ebe61c5890418b23de0b05f6c78d72a.gif

The Pet System is a "quality of life (QOL)" system, which should help you progress without giving you major stat boosts.


 64 Pets to unlock
 Different pet traits to mix and match
 Collect all pets to unlock bonuses
 Evolve the pets and build the ultimate companion



Pet Traits

Shapeshifter
This pet trait allows you to turn into the pet itself, moving faster and ignoring enemy collision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/37fcdf194c117652ae7f5fe54a16a06a2ff11923.gif

Soulfetcher
This pet trait allows you to collect the souls of bosses weaker bosses, allowing you to progress with minimal backtracking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/a950d95601269c3864f33c2987bdf7c8de1715f4.gif

Blinker
This pet trait allows you to teleport to maps you've already visited, making it easier to kill bosses you left for later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/4e577a800f9655e68c56e3c31033decd66712afe.gif

Shopper
This pet trait gives you a discount when buying any gear or relic.


Managing Traits
Traits are limited by the pet rarity, each rarity has a limit of how many traits your pet can have, the maximum rank it can achieve, and which traits the pet can unlock.

 COMMON: Can only unlock one trait, the max rank is 3
 RARE: Can unlock two traits, the max rank is 5
 EPIC: Can unlock two traits, the max rank is 7, can unlock the Soulfetcher trait
 LEGENDARY: Can unlock three traits, the max rank is 10, can unlock the Soulfetcher trait

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/e66cca26cf38ca9b1dfe0abd1241cdc3c559ce58.gif


Rank
When battling, your pet will gain experience with you. For each monster you defeat, the pet will earn 1 exp (2 for bosses), this value can be affected by the "All or Nothing" skill.


Aether
A new currency harvested from pets. You can set a pet free and get an amount of Aether based on the pet Rank and rarity. You can use Aether to upgrade a pet rank without bringing it to battles.


Codex
There area 64 pets to collect. By collecting a certain amount of pets you'll receive a bonus, being:


 Wild Pets: +1%, +2%, +3% and +4% EXP (10% total)
 Unique Pets: +1%, +2%, +3% and +4% GOLD (10% total)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41900338/e388bfd99c11b8d8ad06dddd43485aabfd4b58e7.gif

Hatching
There are two ways you can hatch a Pet:

 By dropping an egg from monsters
 By buying eggs with Tickets


When hatching you'll get a random pet, the only way to know which pet you will get is by killing mobs with the "paw" icon, these mobs are certain to drop an egg that will hatch the corresponding pet.

That's all for now, feel free to ask questions on our discord channel:
https://discord.gg/krTgX2y27J

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.23.54
notes.notes:
HOUSE KEEPING and QOL    

 general bug fixes and crash fixes
 improved gamepad support
 enabling volume and framerate control on mobile (up to 120fps on selected devices)
 making player animations more responsive to inputs to avoid the "moonwalk effect"
 adding max energy text below current energy
 improving readability for some UI elements
 "breathing" idle animation to the player sprite
 setting battle sound effects to not play more than 8 times a second
 enlarging effect for battle sprites when on hit
 numbers below 9999 are unformatted
 numbers below 1M will only show up to 2 decimal places (99.99k, 99k, 99.9k)
 reducing input lock time when changing maps (less time stopped after loading a map)
 updated Post FX effects to be a bit lighter for mobile devices
 drastically improving the main menu loading, no more 10 seconds lock when going to the main menu
 fixing missing mobs on last normal game map and new maps
 updating +6 +9 and +12 item effect
 reducing player immunity time from 5 to 3 seconds
 updating video skips amount



    NEW STUFF    

 adding 4 new ticket skins
 adding 2 new paid skins
 adding 2 500k heroes after the 200k heroes
 adding 4 new heroes, unlocked by playing the awaken mode
 adding def relics
 hiding locked hero sprites



    BALANCE CHANGES    

 changing Necromancer stat bonus from 50% agi to 50% hp
 buffing Assassin attack bonus from 100% to 125%
 changing valk and crimson base stats to +100% hp and +25% def
 reflecting raw attack instead of the damage taken
 rage now boosts attack instead of damage
 concentration now increases raw attack instead of damage dealt
 buffing level 1 concentration attack boost by +5%
 changing swiftness to AS% bonus, calculated before concentration reduction
 nerfing def relics from 50/80/125 to 50/75/120
 nerfing hp relics from 35/50/70to 35/45/65



    AWAKEN MODE    

 unlocked after beating the Illusion
 you'll start the game from the start but with a stat point boost that increases every time you awaken
 when you awaken you lose all equipment, but all relics are kept
 awaken abilities are unlocked after a certain awakening numbers
 new area with 5 new bosses
